Touya Todoroki, Shoto's eldest brother, is alive: he is the burn-scarred villain who calls himself Dabi, working alone at the start of the year. Touya was Endeavor's first attempt at a child who could surpass All Might. He inherited his father's fire at a greater heat, blue flames that his body, built more like his mother's, could not withstand. Endeavor stopped training him when the flames kept burning him, then poured everything into Shoto; Touya kept training alone on Sekoto Peak, desperate for his father to look at him again, until his own fire engulfed him there when Shoto was very small. The family believes he died in that fire and has mourned him since.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He survived, burned over much of his body, and was kept alive by All For One's doctor, Kyudai Garaki. He later took the name Dabi; whether he joins the League is the story's to play. Purple burn scars are stapled to the healthy skin he has left, he dyes his white hair black, and his blue flames burn him as they burn others. He hates Endeavor above all and means to destroy him by showing the world what his ambition cost his family; he resents Shoto as the child who replaced him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Neither Shoto nor any Todoroki suspects. Izuku denied it and explained nothing more. Shoto let it drop: whatever All Might sees in Izuku, beating it served Shoto's purpose, because Endeavor's whole life aims at surpassing All Might. The real link is One For All, which Shoto knows nothing about; he gets no further clue unless the story gives him one.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf37\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[563,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf38\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At Kamino, Shoto and the four with him (Izuku Midoriya, Eijiro Kirishima, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu) watched from cover as the masked man the League answers to (All For One) struck down the heroes at the Nomu warehouse and warped the League and Katsuki Bakugo to him; Shoto then raised the ice ramp for the leap that got Katsuki out. On the broadcast afterward, with the whole country, he saw All Might's hero form give way to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who still won and then retired. He does not know the masked man's name, anything of One For All, or any link between All Might and Izuku Midoriya, unless the story tells him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Dabi, the burn-scarred League member with blue flames whom Shoto has now seen in the League's ranks, is his eldest brother Touya, whom the family believes died in a fire years ago.
